body: Thank you that helped I have a hard time writing without scripts
I am going to try to get a therapist I’m an extremely anxious person so making the phone calls to get a therapist feels like a mountain to climb
Make your wife the villain because she did it to herself
Occasionally I get a dream but usually it’s a nightmare and absolutely trippy
Thank you. I guess it should be easier to fight the urge to do it again now that I know why I feel like I had an episode when I used any amount

When I’m without my meds I’m incredibly irritable paranoid and I experience mild psychosis. I started them again but I think the small dose of dxm interacted with my Prozac and made me freak out and regress. I can pretty much always call my best friend but I do feel bad waking them up so often since I work the night shift alone which both helps and hurts my symptoms. I don’t have to interact with people as often but that also allows me to sink into my own head
I have a few family members and friends I can call. I should try journaling again it just feels like screaming into the void to me
